name: Nitani Tetora
source:
"... Thank you. It's the first time I've been told that way."

A university student at a prestigious national university in Tokyo.
She is in charge of the Ochi within the group.

She was recruited by Nyamo, a magical creature, to be both a magical girl and an idol. She is a magical girl and an idol at the same time.

She is a very fast-paced person, and even during live performances, she seems to be in a relaxed mood.

Rather than being passionless, she is the type of person who doesn't show much emotion.

Fans accept and support her, including her behavior.

She also wants to do something about it, but he doesn't know if she can. There is even a scene in which she asks the main protagonist how to be an idol.

Her favorite food is salmon roe.

Accompanying magical creature: Nyamo (cat)
